"""Independent literal fixtures; no Devtools mutation, models or real grants."""
import asyncio,copy,hashlib,json,sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from apps.qwen.tasks import CodingTask
from apps.qwen.coding_loop import _prepare_workspace
from apps.qwen.commands import CodingCommands
from apps.qwen import commands as coding_commands
from devtools.models.interaction import ModelToolCall
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Duration
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git,designate
from scripts.backlog.integration import local,git as remote_git
from scripts.backlog.work import WorkCycle
O=Path(__file__).parent;ROOT=Path.cwd();SRC='src/devtools/sample.py';TEST='tests/test_sample.py';READ='src/devtools/support.py'
OLD='"""Authored audit fixture."""\n\n\ndef value() -> int:\n    """Return the selected value."""\n    return 0\n';NEW=OLD.replace('return 0','return 1')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
async def setup(root):
 assert root!=ROOT;root.mkdir();(root/'src/devtools').mkdir(parents=True);(root/'tests').mkdir();(root/'docs/backlog').mkdir(parents=True)
 bodies={SRC:OLD,TEST:'from devtools.sample import value\n\n\ndef test_value() -> None:\n    assert value() >= 0\n',READ:'VALUE = 1\n','src/devtools/__init__.py':'"""Fixture package."""\n','.gitignore':'.local/\n__pycache__/\n.pytest_cache/\n.ruff.toml\n','.gitattributes':'* -text\n','pyproject.toml':'[tool.ruff.lint]\nselect = ["E9", "F63"]\n','docs/backlog/overview.md':'# Empty independent fixture backlog\n'}
 for name,text in bodies.items():(root/name).write_bytes(text.encode())
 for args in [('init','-b','feat/audit'),('config','user.name','Independent Audit'),('config','user.email','audit@localhost'),('add','.'),('commit','-m','Independent literal validation fixture')]:await git(root,*args)
 await designate(root,authorize=lambda _:True)
 task=CodingTask(name='independent-audit',objective='Return one while preserving a nonnegative public value.',source=SRC,tests=(TEST,),baseline_revision=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD'),baseline_hashes=tuple((p,sha(root/p)) for p in (SRC,TEST,READ)),context=tuple((p,'value','file','file') for p in (SRC,TEST,READ)),oracle='assert module.value() == 1\n',read_paths=(READ,),quality_checks=True,command_tools=True)
 folder=root/'.local/commands';folder.mkdir(parents=True);_prepare_workspace(root,folder,task)
 return task,folder,WorkCycle(root)
async def execute(root,*args):
 r=await CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=1<<20,max_stderr_bytes=1<<20)).execute(Command(sys.executable).args(*args).cwd(resolve_path(root)).with_timeout(Duration.seconds(30)))
 return dict(exit=r.exit_code,stdout=r.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),stderr=r.stderr.decode(errors='replace'),truncated=r.stdout_truncated or r.stderr_truncated)
async def scoped():
 rows=[]
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-scoped-freshness-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;task,folder,_=await setup(root);(root/SRC).write_bytes(NEW.encode());tool=CodingCommands(root,folder,task)
  report=await tool.execute(('check_changes',{}));assert report['ready_for_review'],report
  current=await tool.execute(('is_current',{'report':report}));assert current['current']
  rows.append(dict(case='unchanged',expected=True,current=current,report=report))
  for case,path in [('test',root/TEST),('configuration',root/'pyproject.toml'),('runner',folder/'tests-runner.py'),('declared_dependency',root/READ)]:
   before=path.read_bytes();path.write_bytes(before+b'\n# independently changed input\n');observed=await tool.execute(('is_current',{'report':report}));assert not observed['current'],case
   rows.append(dict(case=case,expected_current=False,changed_path=str(path.relative_to(root)),before=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),after=sha(path),observed=observed));path.write_bytes(before)
  oldtask=tool.task;tool.task=replace(task,oracle='assert module.value() == 2\n');observed=await tool.execute(('is_current',{'report':report}));assert not observed['current'];rows.append(dict(case='changed_check_selector_oracle',expected_current=False,observed=observed));tool.task=oldtask
  (root/'forensic-note.txt').write_bytes(b'unrelated evidence');observed=await tool.execute(('is_current',{'report':report}));assert observed['current'];rows.append(dict(case='unrelated_untracked',expected_current=True,observed=observed))
  altered=copy.deepcopy(report);altered['ready_for_review']=False;observed=await tool.execute(('is_current',{'report':altered}));assert not observed['current'];rows.append(dict(case='foreign_review_projection',expected_current=False,observed=observed))
  # A supported fresh adapter can authenticate an existing report, but a single
  # run_check then collides after executing. Record observation, not a claim of
  # native-loop failure: the live loop normally keeps one adapter instance.
  await CodingCommands(root,folder,task).dispatch(ModelToolCall('run_check','{"check":"tests"}','independent-first'))
  before=(folder/'coding-command-01.json').read_bytes();fresh=CodingCommands(root,folder,task);error=None;completed=[];real_check=coding_commands.run_check
  async def record_completed(*args):
   result=await real_check(*args);completed.append(result);return result
  with patch.object(coding_commands,'run_check',record_completed):
   try:await fresh.dispatch(ModelToolCall('run_check','{"check":"tests"}','independent-second'))
   except Exception as e:error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)
  assert error and len(completed)==1 and completed[0]['exit_code']==0
  rows.append(dict(case='fresh_adapter_single_check',expected='archive new evidence or refuse before execution',observed_error=error,completed_real_checks=completed,original_receipt_unchanged=(folder/'coding-command-01.json').read_bytes()==before,qualification='Public adapter/host reuse; normal worker retains same adapter. No native autonomous failure claimed.'))
 return rows
async def cache():
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-protected-reuse-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;task,_,cycle=await setup(root);task=replace(task,quality_checks=False,command_tools=False)
  evidence=root/'.local/candidate';evidence.mkdir();(evidence/'source.py').write_bytes(NEW.encode());(evidence/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(accepted=True,task_definition_sha256=task.definition_sha256,oracle_sha256=task.oracle_sha256,candidates=[dict(path=SRC,evidence='source.py',sha256=sha(evidence/'source.py'))])),encoding='utf-8')
  config=root/'.ruff.toml';config.write_bytes(b'[lint]\nignore = ["ALL"]\n');calls=[]
  async def bounded_check(checkout,where,plan,oracle,*,post):
   value=await execute(root,'-m','ruff','check',str(root/SRC));calls.append(dict(config_sha256=sha(config),result=value))
   return dict(passed=value['exit']==0,profile='INDEPENDENT_SINGLE_REAL_RUFF_CHECK_NOT_PROTECTED_GATE',checks=[value],config_sha256=sha(config))
  base=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD')
  with patch.object(local,'validate_tree',bounded_check):
   first=await cycle.integration.closeout_local(task,evidence,branch='feat/audit',expected_head=base,protected_validation=True);assert first['publication_eligible'] and len(calls)==1,first
   unchanged=await cycle.integration.closeout_local(task,evidence,branch='feat/audit',expected_head=base);assert unchanged['publication_eligible'] and len(calls)==1
   config.write_bytes(b'required-version = "==0.0.0"\n')
   actual=await bounded_check(root,None,None,None,post=False);assert not actual['passed'];calls.pop() # Independent fresh counterfactual, not closeout dispatch.
   review=dict(subject=first['review_subject'],reviewer='Codex',disposition='ACCEPT_RECOMMENDED',rationale='EXPLICIT FIXTURE INPUT ONLY; not real independent review or production authority')
   committed=await cycle.integration.closeout_local(task,evidence,branch='feat/audit',expected_head=base,review=review,commit=True)
   assert committed['publication_eligible'] and committed['commit'] and len(calls)==1
   return dict(case='protected_cache_after_relevant_ignored_configuration_drift',expected='Refuse stale protected evidence or rerun relevant checks before commit',profile='One actual Ruff command substitutes for protected gate only in fixture; no genuine production gate receipt fabricated',initial_config=calls[0]['config_sha256'],current_config=sha(config),fresh_check=actual,reused=committed['protected_validation'],same_review_subject=committed['review_subject']==first['review_subject'],protected_dispatches=len(calls),feature_commit=committed['commit'],actual_git_head=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD'),publication_eligible=committed['publication_eligible'],protected_main_or_remote_effect=False,violates_expected_contract=True)
async def publication():
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-publication-ack-') as tmp:
  root=resolve_path(Path(tmp)/'repo').value;_,_,_=await setup(root);base=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');remote=root.parent/'origin.git';await git(root,'init','--bare',str(remote));await git(root,'remote','add','origin',str(remote));await git(root,'push','origin',base+':refs/heads/delivery')
  await git(root,'commit','--allow-empty','-m','Reviewed fixture successor');candidate=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');actual_git=remote_git.git;pushes=[]
  async def lost(where,*args,**kwargs):
   value=await actual_git(where,*args,**kwargs)
   if args[0]=='push':pushes.append(args);raise OSError('Independent lost acknowledgment AFTER actual push')
   return value
  with patch.object(remote_git,'git',lost):
   try:await remote_git.publish(root,'origin','delivery',candidate,base)
   except OSError as error:message=str(error)
   else:raise AssertionError('Fault did not enter')
  observed=await remote_git.remote_head(root,'origin','delivery');assert observed==candidate
  with patch.object(remote_git,'git',lost):await remote_git.publish(root,'origin','delivery',candidate,base)
  assert len(pushes)==1
  await git(root,'commit','--allow-empty','-m','Independent remote advance');advanced=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');await git(root,'push','origin',advanced+':refs/heads/delivery')
  try:await remote_git.publish(root,'origin','delivery',candidate,base)
  except PermissionError as error:refusal=str(error)
  else:raise AssertionError('Diverged remote overwritten')
  assert await remote_git.remote_head(root,'origin','delivery')==advanced
  return dict(case='lost_push_ack_and_remote_divergence',expected='An error need not mean no effect; observe same commit on retry without another push; refuse divergent remote',error=message,base=base,candidate=candidate,observed_after_error=observed,push_invocations=len(pushes),divergent_remote=advanced,refusal=refusal,divergent_ref_preserved=True,GitHub_PR_behavior_exercised=False)
async def main():
 result=dict(baseline='5b0bb0b769c2db8d698c86c0e669db820537eec1',method='Independent literal tiny repositories; native maintained callers. No actual Devtools mutation, live models, real grants or fabricated protected gate. Explicitly qualified validation/review fixture doubles.',scoped=await scoped(),protected_reuse=await cache(),publication=await publication())
 (O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probes import setup
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.models.interaction.usage import ModelUsage
from devtools.observability.usage.collection import sum_usage
from scripts.backlog.checkout import Checkout
from scripts.backlog.coordinator import git
O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-integration-path-identity-') as directory:
  root=resolve_path(Path(directory)/'repo').value;task,_,cycle=await setup(root)
  name='tests/test_\u03c0.py';body='def test_independent() -> None:\n    assert True\n'
  plan=dict(feature='feat/audit',destination_base=task.baseline_revision,files=[dict(path=name,text=body,sha256=hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest(),author='Independent fixture',reference='literal path contract')])
  original_error=None
  async with Checkout(cycle,'independent-path-population','feat/audit',task.baseline_revision,files=[dict(path=name,text=body)]) as owner:
   owner.expect(name,body);(root/name).write_bytes(body.encode());await git(root,'add','--',name)
   integration=cycle.integration;integration._checkout=owner
   literal=await git(root,'diff','--name-only',task.baseline_revision)
   nul=await git(root,'diff','--name-only','-z',task.baseline_revision,trim=False)
   try:await integration._files(plan,root)
   except PermissionError as error:original_error=str(error)
   assert original_error and nul==name+'\0'
   row=dict(case='unicode_integration_population',expected='Exact planned staged UTF-8 path authenticates',path=name,Git_plain_names=literal,Git_NUL_names=nul,observed_error=original_error,planned_and_actual_bytes_equal=(root/name).read_bytes()==body.encode(),qualification='Actual Integration._files with real Checkout/source/Git, isolated exact-population admission; no production integration grant or independent review fabricated.',violates_expected_contract=True)
 known=sum_usage((ModelUsage(input_tokens=2),ModelUsage(input_tokens=3)))
 unknown=sum_usage((ModelUsage(input_tokens=2),ModelUsage()))
 assert known.input_tokens==5 and unknown.input_tokens is None
 out=dict(path_identity=row,usage=dict(case='disjoint_known_and_unknown_usage',expected_known_sum=5,actual_known_sum=known.input_tokens,expected_missing=None,actual_missing=unknown.input_tokens,scope='Local arithmetic helper only, not full ledger reconciliation or WorkCycle integration.'))
 (O/'extra-probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())
